name: How long does wind damage repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does wind damage repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of wind damage repair varies based on the extent of the damage and the materials needed. Minor repairs, such as replacing a few shingles, can often be completed in a day. More extensive damage requiring larger sections of roof replacement or structural repairs will naturally take longer, potentially several days. After our initial assessment, we can provide a more accurate timeline and communicate expectations clearly for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on damage severity, from a day for minor fixes to several days for extensive work. We provide an estimated timeline after assessment.
